future_phase_title: Pursue Goal — CRSP Licensed Source Landing, Admission, and Point-in-Time Canonical Panel Construction

steps.name: VERIFY_SIGNED_ENTITLEMENT
steps.action: Verify the signed entitlement, incorporated schedules, effective license, exact product, users, machines, retention rights, and dates.

steps.name: SECURE_CREDENTIAL_HANDLING
steps.action: Establish separately approved credential handling without writing secrets to Git, logs, prompts, reports, or manifests.

steps.name: IMMUTABLE_LANDING_ROOT
steps.action: Create the separately authorized immutable licensed-source landing area under the approved storage and license boundary.

steps.name: AUTHORIZED_DOWNLOAD_CENSUS
steps.action: Download only the exact files, releases, manifests, schemas, notes, and documentation authorized by the signed entitlement.

steps.name: PRESERVE_ORIGINAL_FILES
steps.action: Preserve original filenames, archive containers, byte sequences, directory structure, and delivery metadata without transformation.

steps.name: COMPUTE_SOURCE_HASHES
steps.action: Compute content hashes for every landed file and bind them to the source manifest before parsing.

steps.name: CAPTURE_SCHEMA_VERSIONS
steps.action: Capture and hash every delivered schema, data dictionary, missing-value code set, and field version.

steps.name: CAPTURE_RELEASE_MANIFESTS
steps.action: Capture release identifiers, file censuses, manifests, checksums, and delivery timestamps for each as-received release.

steps.name: CAPTURE_PUBLICATION_CORRECTION_METADATA
steps.action: Capture publication times, correction notes, replacement notices, schema changes, and revision chronology.

steps.name: IMPORT_PERMNO_PERMCO_IDENTITY
steps.action: Import PERMNO as tradable-security identity and PERMCO as issuer relationship without conflating their semantics.

steps.name: IMPORT_HISTORICAL_TICKER_INTERVALS
steps.action: Import effective historical ticker intervals, validate reuse, and keep unrelated securities and share classes distinct.

steps.name: IMPORT_HISTORICAL_EXCHANGE_LISTING_INTERVALS
steps.action: Import exchange, venue, listing, OTC-transition, relisting, inactive, and delisting intervals with documented boundary semantics.

steps.name: IMPORT_SECURITY_TYPES
steps.action: Map documented CRSP security and share codes to the frozen V1 taxonomy and quarantine every ambiguous classification.

steps.name: IMPORT_RAW_OHLCV
steps.action: Import only qualified original unadjusted daily open, high, low, close, and volume observations with source revision and session metadata.

steps.name: IMPORT_DISTRIBUTIONS_CORPORATE_ACTIONS
steps.action: Import distributions and corporate actions with source IDs, terms, effective dates, knowledge times, release identity, and revisions.

steps.name: IMPORT_DELISTING_TERMINAL_EVENTS
steps.action: Import delisting and terminal-event metadata, reasons, terms, statuses, and predecessor/successor identifiers without outcome calculations.

steps.name: QUARANTINE_OUTCOME_LIKE_FIELDS
steps.action: Quarantine vendor return fields including DlyRet and DelRet from source-admission, exploratory, feature, and canonical-panel interfaces.

steps.name: BIND_EXCHANGE_CALENDARS
steps.action: Bind source sessions to accepted exchange calendars and classify every unexpected, missing, early-close, or timezone discrepancy.

steps.name: RUN_SOURCE_ADMISSION_GATEWAY
steps.action: Run the maintained fail-closed source-admission gateway against exact source, schema, license, archive, and revision metadata.

steps.name: RUN_FULL_CORPUS_VALIDATION
steps.action: Run identity, interval, security-type, bar-integrity, survivorship, action, terminal, timestamp, lineage, and revision checks across the full corpus.

steps.name: QUARANTINE_UNRESOLVED_RECORDS
steps.action: Quarantine every invalid, ambiguous, incomplete, unlicensed, outcome-bearing, or causally unresolved record with explicit reason codes and counts.

steps.name: BUILD_CANONICAL_PANEL
steps.action: Build the source-qualified point-in-time stock-date panel only after every mandatory source family passes admission.

steps.name: RUN_REAL_SOURCE_PREFIX_INVARIANCE
steps.action: Verify that source-truncated and full-source builds are identical through deterministic historical cutoffs.

steps.name: RUN_REAL_SOURCE_FUTURE_MUTATION_INVARIANCE
steps.action: Mutate records strictly after cutoff and prove no historical identity, universe, event, bar, or input at or before cutoff changes.

steps.name: RUN_CURRENT_SNAPSHOT_POISONING
steps.action: Corrupt or remove current identity snapshots in isolation and prove qualified historical results are unaffected.

steps.name: RUN_REVISION_ISOLATION
steps.action: Prove later source releases and corrections cannot rewrite an earlier as-of historical view.

steps.name: RERUN_SOURCE_READINESS_GATE
steps.action: Recompute historical_source_readiness_gate_v2 from admitted real-source evidence without weakening any mandatory gate.

steps.name: KEEP_REAL_OUTCOMES_DISABLED
steps.action: Verify the outcome firewall remains default-deny; source readiness does not unlock labels, outcomes, training, evaluation, backtesting, or holdout access.
